clock_first_failure.scope: stdlib arithmetic on the inspected CAS transition; not execution of Rust atomics or a concurrency test; first successful CAS wins

constructor_clock_observation: Original profile/control/channel only store the callback in construction; the active sampling resides in later owner execution. This layer has no serving/Config installation entry and returns only the opaque wrapper.
final_splice_table: FINAL_MOUNT_SPLICES.json; original intermediate MOUNT_SPLICES is retained but not used as the final source contract
limitations: No Rust compilation, formatter, QA/collector, test, model inference, original owner execution, native/H call, source or ref writes.
No claim of full CLI/orchestration completion or IPC/cold-recovery success.
Old local Cell/runtime remain unchanged and not claimed MAX-safe; later assembly must stay in this private subtree and use the reviewed remote path.
Descriptor checks establish exact current role metadata and pairwise identities, not global absence of dup descriptors or physical cross-owner atomicity.
Original witness/journal recovery may change durable state before a later refusal; error is not no-effect or permission for retry.
Postcondition deadline checks cannot guarantee interrupting a blocking OS call at the exact deadline.
This reference enumeration is for the complete frozen changed view plus relevant original reference chain, not arbitrary future Rust consumers.
